name: claude-excel-skills
title_zh: 十二个技能把财务模型从骨架搭到敏感性分析
tagline_zh: 在 Claude 里说清业务假设，它按模型架构、驱动项、情景、敏感性、公式审计五段往下推。
tagline_en: Describe your business assumptions in Claude; it works through architecture, drivers, scenarios, sensitivity and.
desc_en: 12 Claude skills for building financial models in Excel: model architecture, driver builds, scenarios, sensitivity analysis and formula audit. Built by Oria.
why_zh: 拆成 12 个技能而不是一个大提示，每段可单独重跑：改驱动项不用重搭整张表，审计也只查公式不动结构。
why_en: Split into 12 skills rather than one mega-prompt, so each stage reruns alone: change a driver without rebuilding the sheet.
limit_zh: 只覆盖标准三表模型这一路，DCF、LBO、并购合并它不碰；产物是 xlsx 文件。
limit_en: Covers standard three-statement models only; no DCF, LBO or merger accounting. Output is an xlsx needing a local Excel-capable setup, and it won't.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 12 Claude skills that build an Excel financial model end.
